subject: maths

concepts.title: Trigonometric Ratios of an Acute Angle
concepts.definition: Ratios comparing lengths of pairs of sides in a right-angled triangle relative to one of its acute angles, defining sine, cosine, and tangent.
concepts.formula: sin(A) = opp / hyp, cos(A) = adj / hyp, tan(A) = opp / adj
concepts.key_idea: Trigonometric ratios connect side lengths of a right triangle to its acute angles.
question_patterns: find sin A cos A and tan A from right triangle sides
calculate sine and cosine of an acute angle given side lengths
determine primary trigonometric ratios of an acute angle
what are the trigonometric ratios for angle A in a right triangle

solution_steps.explain: use pythagoras theorem given opposite and adjacent sides
sine is side opposite to angle divided by hypotenuse
cosine is side adjacent to angle divided by hypotenuse
tangent is side opposite divided by side adjacent

concepts.title: Reciprocal Trigonometric Ratios
concepts.definition: Ratios formed by taking the multiplicative inverses of the primary trigonometric ratios, defining cosecant, secant, and cotangent.
concepts.formula: cosec(A) = 1 / sin(A), sec(A) = 1 / cos(A), cot(A) = 1 / tan(A)
concepts.key_idea: Cosecant, secant, and cotangent are reciprocal ratios of sine, cosine, and tangent respectively.
question_patterns: calculate cosecant secant and cotangent of an angle
find cosec A sec A and cot A given triangle side lengths
determine reciprocal trigonometric ratios from given primary ratios
what are cosec sec and cot for angle A

solution_steps.explain: cosecant is hypotenuse divided by opposite side
secant is hypotenuse divided by adjacent side
cotangent is adjacent side divided by opposite side

concepts.title: Finding All Trigonometric Ratios Given One Ratio
concepts.definition: Determining all six trigonometric ratios when one ratio is given, by modeling side lengths with a scaling constant and computing the third side via the Pythagorean theorem.
concepts.key_idea: A single known trigonometric ratio fixes side proportions, enabling determination of all other ratios.
question_patterns: given tan A find other trigonometric ratios
given sin A calculate cos A and tan A
given sec theta find all other trigonometric ratios
calculate remaining ratios given cot theta

solution_steps.action: determine unknown side using pythagoras theorem
solution_steps.explain: solve for adjacent side when hypotenuse and opposite side are known
divide adjacent side by hypotenuse
divide opposite side by adjacent side

concepts.definition: Exact values of trigonometric functions evaluated at special acute angles of 30, 45, and 60 degrees using geometric properties.
concepts.key_idea: Angles of 30, 45, and 60 degrees have constant exact trigonometric values derived from basic geometry.

concepts.title: Trigonometric Ratios of Boundary Angles 0° and 90°
concepts.definition: Limiting values assumed by trigonometric ratios as an acute angle in a right triangle approaches 0 or 90 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: At 0 degrees opposite side reduces to zero, while at 90 degrees adjacent side reduces to zero.

concepts.title: Fundamental Pythagorean Identity
concepts.definition: An essential identity establishing that the sum of squares of sine and cosine of any angle equals one.
concepts.key_idea: The sum of squares of sine and cosine for any valid angle is always identically equal to 1.
question_patterns: find cos A given sin A using identity
calculate sin A when cos A is known
evaluate cos^2 A + sin^2 A
verify sin^2 theta + cos^2 theta equals 1

concepts.title: Secant-Tangent Pythagorean Identity
concepts.definition: A trigonometric identity relating tangent and secant derived by dividing the fundamental Pythagorean relation by cos^2(A).
concepts.key_idea: One plus the square of tangent of an angle equals the square of its secant.
question_patterns: find sec A given tan A using identity
calculate tan A given sec A
evaluate sec^2 A - tan^2 A
express sec A in terms of tan A

solution_steps.explain: square the given tangent value
take square root of 1 plus tan_sq

concepts.title: Cosecant-Cotangent Pythagorean Identity
concepts.definition: A trigonometric identity connecting cotangent and cosecant formed by dividing the fundamental Pythagorean relation by sin^2(A).
concepts.key_idea: One plus the square of cotangent of an angle equals the square of its cosecant.
question_patterns: find cosec A given cot A using identity
calculate cot A given cosec A
evaluate cosec^2 A - cot^2 A
express cosec A in terms of cot A

solution_steps.explain: square the given cotangent value
take square root of 1 plus cot_sq

concepts.definition: Technique of demonstrating algebraic equivalence between two trigonometric expressions using fundamental identities and reciprocal relations.
concepts.key_idea: Transform LHS to RHS using algebraic identities and standard trigonometric relations.
